subject: Clarify BAA eligibility & PHI handling — Stoke Health intake scenarios
messages:
From: Alice Moreau <alice@stoke-health.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@stoke-health.com
Date: Tue, 10 Jan 2028 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: BAA question + PHI intake scenarios

Hi Neha,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the inference latency. Before we can proceed to procurement, our legal and security teams need clarity on whether Redwood would be a Business Associate under HIPAA for our planned integration.

Two quick scenarios:
1) Patients upload scanned lab reports (PDFs) via our web portal; we extract text with OCR and run clinical summarization.
2) Clinicians use an audio note feature; recordings are transcribed server-side and then run through the model.

Questions: will either scenario require a signed BAA? Are there deployment or configuration constraints (hosted vs dedicated vs private) to avoid PHI touching hosted logs? We attached a short intake flow diagram and started a questionnaire (Stoke_BAA_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx).

Appreciate any pointers and a list of evidence we can give to our security team.

Best,
Alice Moreau
Head of Product, Stoke Health
Attachment: Stoke_BAA_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx (xlsx)
Attachment: intake_flow_diagram.png (image)

From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Alice Moreau <alice@stoke-health.com>
Cc: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jan 2028 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: BAA question + PHI intake scenarios

Hi Alice — thanks for the detail and the attachments (received). Short answer up front: both scenarios are likely to fall under PHI handling that would trigger a BAA if personal identifiers are present in the data you send to the model.

A few clarifying points so we can give precise guidance to legal/security and map to evidence:
- Are the lab PDFs OCRed client-side (browser/mobile) or server-side in your environment?
- For audio, do you plan to send raw audio to Redwood for transcription or send transcripts created in your environment?
- Do you need model outputs to be stored long-term in Redwood logs or can you use transient requests with TTL and no persistent storage?

What we can provide immediately: our standard BAA template, SOC 2 attestation, sample ingestion log (redacted), and a configuration checklist for Dedicated/Private options that reduce our exposure surface. I'll loop in Dev for technical details about transcription and retention controls.

Next steps proposal: Dev will confirm what options are technically feasible; Marcus will weigh-in on commercial/BAA timelines. Can you confirm your legal team's preferred turnaround for a drafted BAA (typical stove is 2-3 weeks)?

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Compliance, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
Attachment: sample_ingestion_log.txt (txt)

From: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Alice Moreau <alice@stoke-health.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jan 2028 11:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: BAA question + PHI intake scenarios

Hi Alice — quick technical notes:

Scenario A (scanned PDFs):
- If you OCR on client or in your VPC and only send de-identified text to Redwood, a BAA is not required.
- If PDFs are uploaded to our hosted ingestion endpoint and OCR/transcription happens on our side with identifiers, that is PHI processing and would require a BAA.

Scenario B (audio notes):
- Best practice to keep PHI off hosted paths: do client-side transcription or transcribe within your private environment, then send redacted/unidentified snippets.
- If you must send audio for server-side transcription, we recommend Dedicated or Private; Dedicated can be isolated but still shares control plane metadata unless configured for no-logging; Private (VPC/on-prem) gives the strongest separation and customer-controlled KMS.

Retention & logs:
- We support request-level ephemeral mode (no persistent model outputs, 0 retention) for hosted customers; however, some ancillary logs (request id, timing) exist unless you opt into a dedicated/no-logging profile.
- For strict PHI flows we suggest Dedicated with the "no-persistent-output" flag and explicit log redaction.

I'll attach a sample ingestion log (redacted) and a short checklist of config flags you can request from your engineering team.

— Dev
Dev Patel
Staff Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: sample_ingestion_log.txt (txt)

From: Alice Moreau <alice@stoke-health.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@stoke-health.com
Date: Fri, 13 Jan 2028 08:53:00 -0800
Subject: Re: BAA question + PHI intake scenarios

Thanks — that's helpful. A couple follow-ups from legal/security:
1) What elements in your ingestion/application logs are considered "ancillary"? They want an explicit sample log line showing fields and retention.
2) Does Redwood have a documented DPIA or a template we can use that maps data flows to risks? Our privacy officer prefers seeing a DPIA if a BAA will be needed.
3) If we choose Dedicated with no-persistent-output, can we get a contractual clause that requires Redwood to delete ephemeral outputs within X hours and not use them for telemetry/quality improvements?

We prefer a ~2 week turnaround for a draft BAA to align with our procurement window.

Regards,
Alice
Attachment: Stoke_BAA_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx (xlsx)

From: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Alice Moreau <alice@stoke-health.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jan 2028 10:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: BAA question + PHI intake scenarios

Alice — thanks for the concrete asks. Commercial/contractual notes:
- 2 week draft BAA turnaround is feasible. We'll include a deletion SLA for ephemeral outputs (we typically default to 0 hours for ephemeral mode, but we'll commit to an explicit clause, e.g., deletion within 24 hours if you require a contractual window).
- Telemetry: we can include a clause disallowing using customer data from Dedicated/Private for model improvement; for hosted customers we typically have a telemetry opt-out as part of an enterprise plan.
- DPIA: Redwood maintains a DPIA template for customers that maps data flows to controls; we'll provide that as evidence.

Operational ask to help speed review: please confirm which path you will use for OCR/transcription (client-side, Stoke server-side, or Redwood-side) and whether you require Dedicated or Private for the initial pilot. If you pick Dedicated with the "no-persistent-output" profile, Dev will schedule a short runbook call to validate flags and log redaction settings.

I'll kick off the legal draft once we get that confirmation. Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
Attachment: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1IntakeFlow/view (intake flow link)

From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Alice Moreau <alice@stoke-health.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jan 2028 09:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BAA question + PHI intake scenarios — proposed MAP & evidence bundle

Alice — putting a short mutual action plan here to keep timelines tight:
- Today (Jan 18): Stoke confirms OCR/transcription path and pilot deployment choice (Hosted-Dedicated-Private).
- Jan 19–22: Redwood legal drafts BAA; Redwood Compliance shares DPIA template and SOC 2 attestation and a redacted sample ingestion log.
- Jan 23–26: Technical runbook call (Dev + Stoke eng) to validate flags and log redaction (30–45m).
- Jan 29: Finalize BAA and sign or schedule negotiation cadence.

Evidence bundle we'll upload to your secure Drive folder: DPIA_template_v1.docx, SOC2_Attestation_2027.pdf, redacted_ingestion_log_sample.txt, config_checklist_dedicated_private.pdf. Please confirm that HubSpot deal DEAL-8742 should be used for routing internal approvals.

If Stoke confirms Dedicated/no-persistent-output for the pilot we will mark the account as "BAA pending/eligible" and accelerate the legal draft. If you prefer hosted with client-side OCR/transcription, we can provide guidance to avoid PHI reaching Redwood at all and skip the BAA.

Thanks — I will circulate the legal draft as soon as Dev confirms config language.

Neha Kapoor
Head of Compliance, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
Attachment: DPIA_template_v1.docx (docx); SOC2_Attestation_2027.pdf (pdf); redacted_ingestion_log_sample.txt (txt)
